Can you suggest some books written by Lassiter Wren and Randle McKay that belong to the Games & Activities category?

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Art of Game Design: A Book of Lenses
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: This book offers a comprehensive look at game design through multiple perspectives, making it a great resource for both aspiring and seasoned game designers.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Game Maker's Toolkit
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A practical guide that delves into the mechanics of game creation, providing insights and techniques for enhancing gameplay.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Game Programming Patterns
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A unique exploration of common programming patterns used in game development, valuable for developers looking to improve their coding skills.

gemma2:9b.title: The baffle book
gemma2:9b.explanation: A unique interactive experience in the Games & Activities genre, this book by Lassiter Wren and Randle McKay challenges readers with puzzles and brain teasers that stimulate critical thinking and creativity. It invites participants to engage in playful problem-solving while enjoying a captivating narrative.

gemma2:9b.title: Mastering the Game of Go: A Strategic Guide for Beginners and Experts
gemma2:9b.explanation: Delves into the intricacies of the ancient board game Go, offering tactical insights and historical context.

gemma2:9b.title: The Art of Competitive Rubik's Cube Solving
gemma2:9b.explanation: A step-by-step guide to solving the Rubik's Cube at a competitive level, with advanced algorithms and training techniques.
